title: EP60005: Financial And Legal Aspects Of Business
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Process for effective financial planning, where to start, types of budgets
preparation, budget a value-added activity, Concise overview of specific ratios
to measure financial performance, liquidity, asset management, profitability,
leverage, market value ratios, and comparative analysis, Venture capital and
its relation to grants and loan opportunities, business laws enshrined in the
Indian constitution, the policies of the state, Income tax structure, the labor
laws, Indian commercial laws, EXIM policies, ACTS and amendments in the
business realm, business and ethics, basic differences in policies between
Indian and American, British laws , managers and the legal environment
